limitations: Experimental projections; not a validated advantage over market models.
Position-specific aging curves are research-informed assumptions, not fitted causal effects.
Draft priors use completed historical cohorts including matched players with zero production; talent is proxied by NFL draft capital.
Status and depth order are daily Sleeper snapshots, not a live injury feed.
Scoring spread uses up to 17 statistical appearances; byes and missing zero-stat games are excluded. Median ± SD is descriptive, not a prediction interval.
Advanced statistics are available only where provided.
Pick curves are provisional research assumptions.
